set.body: Deferred strategic review. Keep Gale core independent and retain copy-only interop for now. Reconsider making Ravel the storage substrate for DVec and DMat only after Ravel has allocation-free fixed-rank indexing, a stable monomorphic Double kernel-view SPI, consuming ownership-transfer builders, explicit layout-compatibility rules, and JVM/Scala.js differential benchmarks showing Gale hot paths are neutral or faster. Preserve DVec/DMat as Gale mathematical types; keep dependency direction Gale -> Ravel and never put linear algebra into Ravel.
set.title: Revisit Ravel-backed Gale dense storage
